units.source_text: 大象用团扇般的茶褐色大耳朵扇动着脸颊。

en.t: The elephant fanned its cheeks with its large tea-brown ears, like round fans.
But its cheeks did not feel cool at all.

units.source_text: 它那双似乎没有骨头的腿上，仿佛穿了一条又肥又大的旧裤子。

en.t: On its two legs, which seemed to have no bones, it looked as though it were wearing a pair of loose, oversized old trousers.
